Name: parseInt
Description: Parses a string argument and returns an integer of the specified radix or base.

Name: parseFloat
Description: Parses a string argument and returns a floating point number.

Name: isNaN
Description: Determines whether a value is NaN (Not-a-Number) or not.

Name: encodeURI
Description: Encodes a Uniform Resource Identifier (URI) by replacing each instance of certain characters with escape sequences.

Name: decodeURI
Description: Decodes a Uniform Resource Identifier (URI) previously created by encodeURI.

Name: Math.abs
Description: Returns the absolute value of a number.

Name: Math.ceil
Description: Rounds a number up to the next largest integer.

Name: Math.floor
Description: Rounds a number down to the nearest integer.

Name: Math.round
Description: Returns the value of a number rounded to the nearest integer.

Name: Math.max
Description: Returns the largest of zero or more numbers.

Name: Math.min
Description: Returns the smallest of zero or more numbers.

Name: Math.random
Description: Returns a floating-point, pseudo-random number in the range 0 (inclusive) up to but not including 1 (exclusive).

Name: Math.sqrt
Description: Returns the square root of a number.

Name: Math.pow
Description: Returns the base raised to the exponent power.

Name: JSON.parse
Description: Parses a JSON string, constructing the JavaScript value or object described by the string.

Name: JSON.stringify
Description: Converts a JavaScript value or object into a JSON formatted string.

Name: Array.isArray
Description: Determines whether the passed value is an Array.

Name: Array.from
Description: Creates a new, shallow-copied Array instance from an array-like or iterable object.

Name: Object.keys
Description: Returns an array of a given object's own enumerable property names.

Name: Object.values
Description: Returns an array of a given object's own enumerable string-keyed property values.

Name: Object.assign
Description: Copies all enumerable own properties from one or more source objects to a target object.

Name: Date.now
Description: Returns the number of milliseconds elapsed since January 1, 1970 00:00:00 UTC.

Name: Date.parse
Description: Parses a string representation of a date, and returns the number of milliseconds since epoch.

Name: console.log
Description: Outputs a message to the debugging console.

Name: console.error
Description: Outputs an error message to the debugging console.

Name: console.warn
Description: Outputs a warning message to the debugging console.
